description: Persistent autonomous goals for pi — /goal command, create_goal/get_goal/update_goal tools, token budgets, and the pi-goal-writer skill (upstream skill lives at skills/pi-goal-writer/)
customizations: updateStatusBar passes undefined instead of "" when there is no goal, so the footer status row stays empty instead of rendering a blank line

pause on abort: turn_end treats stopReason === "aborted" as a user pause (usage still charged, agent_end does not re-queue a continuation) — ported from the unmerged upstream branch fix/pause-on-escape, commit 3078686. Guarded by test/abort-pauses.test.cjs
